notes: The 5.2L CHT-sensor article’s access cross-reference names the 5.0L intake manifold. G1800279 is the matching local 5.2L intake-manifold procedure; use that branch and explicitly identify this corrected access route, without borrowing the 5.0L tightening sequence. G1802175 identifies the 5.2L CHT sensor as rear-view item 13.

The heater-core article lists base-engine housing routes but omits the local 5.2L housing procedure G1800364. That procedure directly disconnects the heater-core hoses and removes the housing; it supplies the matching 5.2L branch. G1912328 supplies the actual isolated heater-core leak check, which is distinct from a whole cooling-system pressure test.
The named Power Door Window Initialization procedure resolves locally to G1957566. Follow its actual initialization conditions after adjustment.

The engine assembly article later says to disconnect the LH VCT connectors after connecting them earlier. The dedicated same-engine LH valve-cover installation explicitly connects those connectors; the RH installation also connects its VCT connectors. Use these dedicated instructions as corroboration that both banks are connected at completion, and briefly identify the conflicting assembly wording rather than silently presenting it as correct.

The 2.3L oil-pan procedure pairs a 3 mm bead with 0.19 in, which are inconsistent. The same-engine assembly procedure independently specifies a 3 mm oil-pan bead, with the same TA-357/WSE-M4G323-A6 sealant and 10-minute installation limit. State the corroborated metric 3 mm dimension only, with a brief dimensional-discrepancy note; do not invent a replacement imperial value.

The TR3160 transmission installation explicitly directs clutch-system filling and bleeding to G1704358, despite that shared procedure’s inherited MT82 section label. The remaining authoring job covers only 5.2L because the existing maintenance guide covers the base engines. Do not title this 5.2L guide MT82.
